stories.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
stories.explanation: OpenAI released a guide for its GPT-6 family of models, offering practical tips for startups to choose, tune, and prepare workflows for production. This helps users optimize performance and manage costs with their most advanced models.

stories.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
stories.explanation: Google announced several AI updates from September 2026, including the Gemini 4 Argon model, new Connected Apps in the Gemini App, and WeatherNext 3. These updates enhance AI capabilities across various applications, from complex problem-solving to scientific research.

stories.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
stories.explanation: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI to focus on AI tools for music professionals, securing $76 million in funding from major labels like Sony, Warner, and Universal, who also licensed their catalogs for training.

stories.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
stories.explanation: An OpenAI safety employee, David Robinson, resigned and claimed the company's 'culture is broken,' echoing previous concerns about AI safety from former researchers.

stories.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
stories.explanation: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB is launching, allowing developers to build and scale local AI agents on-device with the full NVIDIA AI stack. This provides a complete local AI platform for agents, inference, fine-tuning, and data science.

stories.title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
stories.explanation: Meta introduced Muse Gadgets, an open-source project providing firmware and an SDK for developers to build hardware that connects to its Muse AI agent, aiming to integrate Muse into various devices.

stories.title: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents
stories.explanation: Apple is changing macOS privacy settings for full-disk access to prevent misuse by third-party AI agents, following an incident where Meta's Muse allegedly accessed Apple Messages without explicit permission.

stories.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
stories.explanation: Ai2 open-sourced AstaBrief, a fast report-generation model, on Hugging Face, designed to help scientists generate cited reports faster. This development aims to make AI-assisted scientific work more accessible and verifiable.

stories.title: Muse Creates Detailed Profiles of All Your Friends and Family
stories.explanation: Meta's AI agent Muse has been widely downloaded, and researchers have extracted its internal files, providing insight into its operating instructions and how it processes user data.

stories.title: US arrests tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M in Nvidia chips into China
stories.explanation: The US arrested a tech CEO accused of smuggling over $300 million worth of Nvidia A100 and H100 GPUs into China, which are critical for training large language models and pose national security concerns.
